protocol.selection: Xeon: two passes, higher bulk (GiB/s tiebreak), lower small independently. M2: independent medians of three complete passes.
protocol.variation_flags: max/min - 1 > 0.15; separately max absolute relative deviation from median > 0.15; historical control changes > 0.15
protocol.M2_gate: no SMHasher3 process and 1-minute load <4.5 before every run; poll every 60 seconds, no timeout
protocol.bulk_ratio: shipped bytes/cycle divided by control bytes/cycle; above 1 is faster
protocol.small_ratio: shipped cycles/hash divided by control cycles/hash; above 1 is slower
protocol.cycle_caveat: Xeon RDTSC/RDTSCP; M2 calibrated monotonic-clock cycle estimate. Printed GiB/s assumes 3.5 GHz, not measured frequency.
